notes.title: Patch 1.5.0-d
notes.notes:
We’ve been listening to your reports about texture and lighting problems — thank you for taking the time to share them! Unfortunately, this isn’t an easy fix, but the latest update should help us narrow down where the issue is coming from.  

Without going into all the technical details, we suspect that this problem only affects a specific group of users.  If you see the window attached to this post when the game starts, you’re part of that group: If possible, please share: 
[olist]
A screenshot of this window (the title contains important information for us). 

Screenshots of any rendering issues you notice in your game. This will help us pinpoint the cause much faster.
[/olist]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619249/4260afc34e87eec187dcc45d426143a72de36a57.jpg"]


Other Fixes in This Update: 

Fixed the flashlight during the power outage event (wasn’t working for,

some players).,

Fixed a bug where the final credits rolled very slowly for some users.
Thanks for your patience and continued feedback — it’s making a real difference in improving the game for everyone!

notes.title: 💬 Wait… an update for the base game?!
notes.notes:
“But you said no more updates!”
True – we meant no more content. But that doesn’t mean we won’t polish things up a bit! 😄
So here’s a tiny update with a couple of improvements – and a little teaser for the upcoming DLC!

🆕 What’s new?

🛠️ Revamped Main Menu!
The main menu got a fresh coat of paint and now includes a shiny new DLC selection screen.
There’s nothing there yet – but it’s all set up and ready for what’s coming.
Think of it as a sneak peek to get hyped!

🎁 DLC Teaser Included:
We’re working hard on it, and while we don’t want to make you wait too long,
we also want it to be worth your time. So, here’s a little taste in advance.

🔧 Minor but mighty hotfixes:

🔊 Widescreen audio fix:
Some players with ultrawide monitors couldn’t hear certain sounds (like that voice 😱).
No more silence – now you’ll get the full spooky audio experience, no matter how wide your screen is.

💾 Settings now save properly (lol):
Yeah… they didn’t before.
Now they do. You’re welcome. 😂

🧱 What’s next?
We’re pouring our hearts, minds, and slightly chaotic energy into the DLC.
We want it to be as ridiculous and awesome as possible – without making you wait forever.

❤️ Thanks again for all your support –
This madness only exists because of you. And don’t worry:

It won’t get better.
Only weirder. 😈

– Robin & Saturn91
DreamStudios 🌀

notes.title: 📢 Changelog & outlook
notes.notes:
First of all, a huge thank you for your amazing feedback – you all are incredible! 🎉
We got to work right away and have already optimized a few things. Meanwhile, we’re also working hard on a small content update that will be released tomorrow! 🛠️✨
We want to keep developing A Simple Job together with you – so:
Tell us your wishes!
Whether it’s core improvements, absurd gameplay ideas, or brand-new jobs – everything is welcome.
A basketball hoop? A button with a personality? Or an office with... even more chaos? 🏀💥
Get creative – the coolest ideas might (maybe) make it straight into the game! 😈

💡 And don’t worry: As long as you’re playing A Simple Job, we’ll keep delivering new content – no matter how crazy, absurd, or pointless it may be. The more you press, the more you get back. Promise. 😇🔴

🛠️ Mini-Update – 07. June 🔧

We’ve got a small but sweet update for you:

🥇 New Achievement:


 A brand-new achievement is here – and it lets you mess with the boss a little.


 But be careful: We hope he doesn’t come back twice as fast... 😈



📺 Windowed Mode Option:


 You can now play in windowed mode! You’ll find it in the settings – that means the Settings room. Have fun clicking in and out.



🗺️ Room Display:


 From now on, the game will show which room you’re in in the top right corner. No more getting lost (well... in theory).



🏆 Achievement Help:


 Room specific achievements now show which room you can find them in. Because we know how much you hate searching. 😉 


📚 Community Guide:


 Two of you maniacs actually made a guide on Steam! We love it – and we love you. Thanks for being our test subjects... and yes, you pressed the button. Of course you did. 🔴💥 (you might want to update the guide now for that new achievement xD) 


🛠️ More Fixes & Improvements:

🧱 Ceiling fixed:


 Now you can only leave the map on purpose. No more unauthorized flying adventures! 😅 - I see you misterM!


🎍Plant repaired:


 You can no longer walk through the plant like it’s air. (Jesus why is there always one collider missing!) 


🖼️ Sleep window improved:


 Looks way better on wide screens now – some parts weren’t displaying properly before. Now enjoy sweeter dreams in better resolution. 😌✨



Thanks for playing and for all your support!
Stay weird – and don’t touch the button. Or... maybe do?
